mentions.name: SDK Garden
mentions.description: This tool provides SDK observability, sitting at the intersection of observability, SDKs, and product analytics. It ingests data from monitoring services like Datadog and Sentry to give visibility into SDK usage, filling a gap where no existing SDK observability tooling could be found.
mentions.problem: Nothing existed around SDK observability; the author assumes bigger orgs rely on internal handrolled tools that ingest Datadog/Sentry-style data.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://sdkgarden.com/

been curious about the intersection between observability, SDKs, and product analytics. i couldn't find anything around SDK observability so built this little tool.
